WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN store_id ELSE NULL END AS __selling_store_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_9.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_16.items_per_order) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__valid_order_items) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'
) subq_16
